title: Second moment under homogenization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a_0$ be real, and let $a$ assign a real coefficient to each of the $n$ coordinates. The expected square of the linear form on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube with coefficients $(a_0,a)$ equals the expected square of the affine form with constant term $a_0$ and coefficients $a$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube; both expectations are uniform.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real-valued function on the $n$ coordinates
